n0.text: WOOF! (Translation: Fennel! Good kitten! Good! I have not chased a single rat today. Okay, I chased twelve. Okay, twenty.)

n1.text: Woof. (Translation: the rats went north, into the cave. I can smell them. They smell like betrayal and cheese rind.)

r0.text: Woof! (Translation: go get 'em! I'll guard the farm!)
